<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary debate:</strong> The Lok Sabha witnessed a high-voltage, linguistically unique debate on the anti-paper leak bill, with MPs incorporating Gen Z slang like &quot;delulu&quot; and &quot;FOMO&quot; to highlight student concerns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative deadlock:</strong> The Rajya Sabha was adjourned following opposition demands for a statement from the Home Minister regarding police actions, contributing to significant financial losses due to repeated parliamentary disruptions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political shifts:</strong> Reports indicate the BJP is poised to form governments in West Bengal and Assam while retaining power in Puducherry, even as opposition leaders continue to challenge the government on exam reforms and alleged undisclosed corporate ties.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNNzdwRFNmMjgxUl9WbHREanRRaV9IS1NvaHhDTmtITHlTRjF2cDgxVFRZRlJXbmJtUFhaV0FncmtTX2wtdHJGaTh3dDVRNmh5QTB3S1RQMEs3X3VYRUlRWnlFVW5XUHcwNG5jNXBDSHliZkQ4M3pVTktQWWNweUdCZ1Y0S3ZWZ1gzOENOTHhZNVF1SUhrVEloa3hHYzZCTGk3LUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
</ul>
